title: PUPPET: how to work
text:
# PUPPET: how to work
tags: workflow, order, start
1. Read the request. Pick ONE format (F01-F25) that fits; search "PUPPET format Fxx" for its beats.
2. Pick 2-3 characters (ch_ codes) and 1-2 places (pl_ codes). Use only names from the catalog.
3. Write the joke first, in Russian, as 8-12 short lines. Decide the last line before anything else.
4. Lay the lines on the format beats. One line per shot. 35-55 s total.
5. Compute times: line length = words/2 s + 0.5 s per [pause]; shot = 0.3 s lead + line + 0.4 s tail.
6. Add camera per beat (search "PUPPET camera grammar"), music only where the format needs it, fade in and out.
7. Run check (mode=check). Fix every error by its line number. Never change words to fix timing; move times.
8. If check returns LINES_TO_RECORD, stop and show the list. Do not render.
9. Render once. Do not poll status.
Output only the program, 25-45 lines. Start with 3 comments: # format: F01 Интервью / # logline: ... / # why it works: ...

title: PUPPET: statements
text:
# PUPPET: statements
tags: language, syntax, statements, film, shot, say, voice
One statement per line. # starts a comment. Times end with s. Only these statements exist:
film title="Название" style=puppet fps=24 size=1920x1080   (always the first line)
shot 0-4.6s: ch_dina push=0.05 focus=0.5,0.4   (which set is on screen, camera after the set)
say ch_dina "Реплика." at 0.3s   (on-screen line; the set's mouth moves; voice comes from the set)
voice "[deep] Закадровый текст." at 5s   (off-screen line; [deep] narrator, [ad] commercial voice)
text "НАДПИСЬ" at 0.5,0.18 size=0.07 color=#ffffff glow=#000000 2-6s
prop coffee_cup at 0.7,0.8 size=0.15 bob=0.01 12-18s   (only prop names from the catalog)
music mood=bright tempo=118 35-43s
fade in 0-0.6s   /   fade out 46.6-47s
Rules: the first shot starts at 0s. Shots touch: each starts exactly where the previous ends. All at= and ranges are film seconds, not shot seconds. Every say/text/fade lies inside the film. Words go in double quotes; inside them use «ёлочки», never ".

title: PUPPET: camera parameters of shot
text:
# PUPPET: camera parameters of shot
tags: camera, push, pull, snap, pan, dutch, whip, handheld, shake, focus
push=0.05   slow push in over the whole shot. 0.02 near-still, 0.04-0.06 slow, 0.1 clear, 0.14-0.16 strong. Default 0.04 if you write nothing.
pull=0.25   starts close, pulls back to the whole frame. Reveals. Do not combine with push.
focus=0.5,0.4   point the push moves to (x,y 0..1). Put it on the face.
pan=right   slow drift; left|right|up|down. Adds a small zoom. For landscapes, maps, rows of things.
snap=44.3   crash zoom at that FILM second (must lie inside the shot). Put it on the reaction or at the start of the last line.
handheld=1   uneven wander, like a news or reality camera.
dutch=10   tilted horizon in degrees (8-12, sign gives side). Unease, problems, lies.
whip=left   the shot flies in from the side, 0.35 s. Fast cut between people or a new arrival.
shake=0.003   trembling. Impact, wind, panic. Keep 0.002-0.004.
Combine at most two moves per shot. Never use push above 0.3.

title: PUPPET: sets and voices
text:
# PUPPET: sets and voices
tags: sets, cast, places, voices, who, ch_, pl_
A set is one camera on one character or place. Writers-room names: ch_<code> is a character set with a talking mouth (ch_dina, ch_salmon, ch_piggybank). pl_<code> is a place set without a mouth (pl_tv_studio, pl_court). ad_cream is the beauty-commercial pack shot.
say needs a set with a mouth: say ch_dina "...". A pl_ set never talks; put a voice over it.
Each ch_ set has its own voice; do not write who= on say unless asked.
Who is on screen talks with say on THEIR set. Someone heard but not shown: voice "..." who=<voice>.
Voices: narrator, journalist, lady, calm, fairy, deep, ad, salmon, odessa, gogi.
voice without a tag or who= is the deep narrator. "[ad] ..." is the bright commercial voice.
Never pick an accent voice (odessa, gogi) to match a character's nationality or origin.
Use only set names the catalog returns. Unknown set = check error; search the catalog, do not invent.

title: PUPPET: dialogue timing
text:
# PUPPET: dialogue timing
tags: timing, words per second, at, pause, line length
Speech rate: 2 words per second. Live voices are slower, so never go above 2.
Line length = words / 2 seconds + 0.5 s for every [pause] tag. Tags are not words.
Start each line 0.3 s after its shot begins: shot 12-16s -> say ... at 12.3s.
End the shot 0.4 s after the line ends. Shot length = 0.3 + line + 0.4.
Examples: 4 words = 2 s -> shot 2.7 s (use 3). 8 words = 4 s -> shot 4.7 s (use 5). 12 words = 6 s -> 6.7 s.
Keep lines short: 3-8 words. Over 10 words, split into two shots.
One line per shot. Two lines never overlap.
A silent shot (no line) of 2-3 s before the last line is a beat, not a gap; keep it.
Tags at the start of a line set delivery: [deadpan] [tired] [whispering] [sighs] [calm] [pause]. One or two tags, not more.
When check reports real recording lengths, re-time with the same rule and shift every later shot; never cut words.

title: PUPPET: music, text, fade, props
text:
# PUPPET: music, text, fade, props
tags: music, mood, text, fade, prop, sound
music mood=<wonder|dark|bright|tense|cozy|calm> tempo=<n> A-Bs. Only these six moods.
Music is a range, not a bed. It ducks under speech automatically.
bright 110-120: show openers, game shows, commercial jingles. wonder 70: documentary, nature. cozy 84: family, kitchen. tense 92: court, problems, panic. calm 72: interview, therapy, podcast. dark 66: horror-flavoured documentary.
Stop music 3-6 s before the last line. Silence makes the last line land.
text: short caps, 1-4 words, film seconds, inside one shot. Lower third at 0.5,0.85; slogan at 0.2,0.25 on the empty left of ad_cream. color=#ffffff glow=#000000 on dark; color=#c4426a glow=#ffffff on the ad.
fade in 0-0.6s always. fade out over the last 0.4 s, after the last line ends.
prop only with a name the catalog returns; size 0.1-0.2; one prop at a time.

title: PUPPET: camera grammar
text:
# PUPPET: camera grammar
tags: camera grammar, when to push, snap, dutch, whip, handheld, pull
Serious face, absurd content: the camera behaves like real TV of that genre.
push 0.04-0.06: default for a talking head. Stronger push 0.1 on the strange detail or a confession.
near-still push=0.02: the straight man asking questions; contrast makes the answer funnier.
snap: once or twice per film. Always on the last line or the reaction to it. Not on setup lines.
pull: openings (reveal the studio), the false ending ("спасибо, что пришли"), the final pull-out of a documentary.
handheld: news field reports, reality, unboxing selfie, wedding guests, taxi. Not in a studio interview.
dutch: commercial "problem" beat, lies, guilt, a client in crisis. Never on two shots in a row.
whip: talk-show surprise guest, game-show contestants in turn, family dinner back-and-forth.
pan: landscapes, maps, museum rooms, apartment tours, the table of ingredients.
shake: impacts, gavel, wind at a field report.
Use at least 3 different moves in a film. Never 4 identical shots in a row.

title: PUPPET: camera per format
text:
# PUPPET: camera per format
tags: camera, format, map
Interview F01, podcast F15, therapy F07: slow push on guest, near-still host, push on the pause, pull on the false end, snap on the turn.
Talk show F02: pull from host to hall, whip on the surprise guest, snap in silence.
News F03: still anchor, handheld reporter and witness, snap back to the anchor.
Documentary F04, nature F13: pan the landscape, slow push, handheld whisper (F13), pull out at the end.
Ad F05: dutch on the problem, snap on the product, push on the pack shot, push fast on fine print.
Interview job F06, doctor F21, school F20: mostly still, slow push on the answer, snap on the decision.
Court F08: still judge, push on accuser, handheld defence, whip on the witness, shake on the gavel.
Cooking F09, tutorial F16, unboxing F14: pan over the table, handheld process, push on the result.
Weather F10, game F11, press F12, pitch F18: pull on the opener, whip between players, handheld on the hall.
Taxi F22: handheld always. Museum F23, apartment F24: pan rooms, snap on details. Toast F25: handheld, push on the groom.

title: PUPPET: joke structure
text:
# PUPPET: joke structure
tags: joke, humour, setup, escalation, deadpan, turn
Play the genre perfectly straight. The absurd lives only in the content. No winking, no laughing, no music cue.
Setup (first 5-10 s): name the absurd premise in one plain sentence. "У нас Копилка. Финансовый эксперт."
Deadpan escalation (middle): each beat takes the premise one step further, said calmly as fact. The straight man (host, judge, doctor) asks normal questions; the guest answers with dignity.
Rule of three: two normal items, the third one wrong.
False ending: "Спасибо, что пришли" or a summary. It makes the turn a surprise.
Silence: a 2-3 s silent close-up right before the last line.
Turn (last 3-6 s): one short line that flips the meaning. See "PUPPET last line".
Topics: work, money, technology, bureaucracy, health, family, cities, nature, AI. The system is the target, never a weak person.
Write in Russian. Short words. Concrete nouns beat abstractions.

title: PUPPET: the last line
text:
# PUPPET: the last line
tags: last line, turn, punchline, ending
Decide it first; build the film backwards to it.
2-8 words, never over 10. Plain, concrete, said flat: start it with [deadpan] or [tired].
It sits in the last 3-6 s of the film, alone in its shot, after a 2-3 s silent shot.
It never explains the joke. Nobody reacts to it after; fade out 0.4 s after it ends.
It reveals a fact that reframes everything: who the guest really is, what the prize is, where the advice leads.
Good: «На молоток.» «Пробовал. Там ресторан.» «Не могу. Уйду — займут.» «Человек. Вышло дешевле.»
Bad: a moral, a question to the viewer, a pun, a long sentence, a line that repeats the setup.
Camera: snap at its start (snap=<line at>), or a still close-up if the scene was loud.
Music: already stopped.
Who says it: the format's turn speaker (search "PUPPET format" for "turn").

title: PUPPET: commercial break
text:
# PUPPET: commercial break
tags: commercial, ad, реклама, break, ad_cream, jingle
The break line comes from the host, flat, on a strong push or snap: "Извините. Прерываемся на рекламу." It can be the last line of the film.
An ad inside a film: 6-10 s, 1-2 shots, right after the break line.
Product is invented, never a real brand. The product ties back to the episode's absurd premise (salmon milt cream).
Voice: voice "[ad] ..." over the product set (ad_cream). 1-2 lines, 8-14 words total.
Music: music mood=bright tempo=118 over the ad range only. Start it with the ad, stop it when the ad ends.
Text: 1-2 slogans in caps on the empty left: at 0.2,0.25 and 0.24,0.42, color=#c4426a glow=#ffffff, from 0.2 s after the ad starts to its end.
Camera: push=0.06 focus=0.6,0.5 on the product.
After the ad, return to the studio or flip roles (the guest now interviews a person).
F05 film: the whole film is an ad; the turn is the fine print or the slogan.

title: PUPPET: safety rules
PUPPET: fixing check errors
text:
# PUPPET: fixing check errors
tags: check, error, fix, mode=check
Check answers with "line N: ...". Fix only that line, then run check again.
"no set 'x' on this device" -> search the catalog; take a listed name. Never invent a set.
"set x has no talking mouth" -> the set is a place; use voice "..." instead of say, or put the speaker's ch_ set on screen.
"shots must touch" -> make this shot start where the previous ends; shift all later times by the same amount.
"the first shot must start at 0s" -> first shot 0-...s.
"say needs a start time" / "needs its time" -> add at Xs or A-Bs.
"is outside the film" -> move it inside the shots or extend the last shot.
"unknown voice who=" -> use one of: narrator, journalist, lady, calm, fairy, deep, ad, salmon.
"unclosed quote" -> close the quote; replace inner " with «».
"is not a statement" -> only film, shot, say, voice, text, prop, music, fade.
"recordings do not fit" -> keep words; re-time: line at = shot start + 0.3, shot end = line end + 0.4; shift everything after.
Two failed fixes in a row: rewrite that beat shorter.

title: PUPPET: LINES_TO_RECORD
text:
# PUPPET: LINES_TO_RECORD
tags: LINES_TO_RECORD, recording, voice, elevenlabs, stop
If check returns LINES_TO_RECORD, the program is valid but some lines have no recording yet and the device has no voice key.
Do this:
1. Stop. Do not render. Do not change the program.
2. Show the person the list as a short table: line number, voice (who), text, file path.
3. Say: record these lines with your own voice service, put each file at the given path, then ask me to render.
4. When the person says the files are in place, run check again. Then render once.
Do not rewrite lines to avoid recording. Do not drop lines. Do not retry check in a loop.
After recording, check may report real lengths ("the recordings do not fit"). Then re-time the shots (see "PUPPET: fixing check errors") without changing a single word, so the same recordings are reused.

title: PUPPET format F01-F03: interview, talk show, news
text:
# PUPPET format F01-F03: interview, talk show, news
tags: format, F01, F02, F03, интервью, ток-шоу, новости
F01 Interview 45s: host (ch_dina) + guest with dignity, pl_tv_studio. Intro 0-5 host names guest and merit, push | question 5-15 still | deepen 15-30 host grabs a strange detail, guest close-up, push on the pause | false end 30-38 "спасибо, что пришли", pull | turn 38-45 guest one line, snap. Turn: guest.
F02 Talk show 45s: ch_arsen, pl_talkshow. Opening 0-5 host announces topic, pull | story 5-20 guest's drama, slow push | hall 20-25 audience question, handheld | surprise 25-35 "а теперь к нам выходит...", whip | turn 35-45 new guest says the unexpected, snap, silence. Turn: new guest.
F03 News 45s: anchor ch_dina, reporter ch_timur. Anchor 0-6 still | link 6-10 "наш корреспондент на месте" | report 10-25 handheld | witness 25-35 handheld push | turn 35-45 reporter or witness says the real thing, anchor thanks, snap. Turn: witness/reporter.

title: PUPPET format F04-F06: documentary, ad, job interview
text:
# PUPPET format F04-F06: documentary, ad, job interview
tags: format, F04, F05, F06, документальный, реклама антиреклама, собеседование
F04 Documentary 48s: narrator voice "[deep] ...". Prologue 0-8 place, pan | hero 8-20 chore as heroism, push | interview 20-30 hero close-up | climax 30-40 "И тогда он сделал то, что делал каждый день", music wonder rises | turn 40-48 dry fact, pull, music stops. Turn: narrator.
F05 Ad 45s: problem 0-7 grey, dutch | product 7-12 snap | miracle 12-25 push | expert in white coat 25-32 still | pack shot 32-38 ad_cream, voice [ad], music bright | turn 38-45 fine print or side effect. Anti-ad: idyll 0-6 pull | temptation 6-12 snap | honest harms 12-28 handheld, dutch | expert confirms 28-35 | turn 35-45 cheerful slogan contradicts everything. Turn: [ad] voice.
F06 Job interview 45s: ch_alina + candidate, pl_hr_room. Enter 0-5 | "расскажите о себе" 5-15 still | weaknesses 15-25 slow push | candidate asks about the company 25-35 still, pause | turn 35-45 decision or exposure, snap. Turn: candidate or HR.

title: PUPPET format F07-F09: therapy, court, cooking show
text:
# PUPPET format F07-F09: therapy, court, cooking show
tags: format, F07, F08, F09, терапия, суд, кулинарное шоу
F07 Therapy 45s: ch_mark, pl_therapy. "Что вас привело?" 0-5 | complaint 5-18 slow push | roots 18-30 absurd childhood, push, calm music | exercise 30-38 still | turn 38-45 "время вышло" or client diagnoses the therapist, snap. Turn: either.
F08 Court 45s: judge ch_svetlana, pl_court. Gavel 0-5 shake | accusation 5-15 push | defence 15-28 handheld | witness 28-36 whip | turn 36-45 verdict nobody expected, snap. Turn: judge.
F09 Cooking show 45s: ch_madina, pl_cooking_set. "Сегодня мы готовим..." 0-5 push | ingredients 5-15 each with a caveat, pan | process 15-30 helper interferes, handheld | serving 30-38 slow push | turn 38-45 tasting or confession, snap. Turn: chef or guest.

title: PUPPET format F10-F12: weather, game show, press conference
text:
# PUPPET format F10-F12: weather, game show, press conference
tags: format, F10, F11, F12, погода, игровое шоу, пресс-конференция
F10 Weather 42s: ch_kirill, pl_weather_studio. "Добрый вечер" 0-4 still | map 4-15 pan | advice 15-28 more and more serious, push | guest (ch_cloud, ch_marmot) 28-36 whip | turn 36-42 tomorrow's forecast scares in a new way, snap. Turn: forecaster or guest.
F11 Game show 45s: ch_inna, pl_game_show, music bright. Opening 0-5 pull | question 5-12 push | answers 12-28 contestants in turn, whip | super prize 28-36 snap | turn 36-45 prize or right answer, still, silence. Turn: host.
F12 Press conference 42s: ch_pavel, pl_press_room. Statement 0-8 still | question 8-16 hall handheld | smooth empty answer 16-24 push | awkward question 24-32 handheld push | turn 32-42 slip of the tongue or honest answer, then leaves, snap. Turn: press secretary.

title: PUPPET format F13-F15: nature film, unboxing, podcast
text:
# PUPPET format F13-F15: nature film, unboxing, podcast
tags: format, F13, F14, F15, фильм о природе, распаковка, подкаст
F13 Nature film 48s: ch_aidana whispers, "[whispering]". Ambush 0-8 handheld push | observation 8-20 the "species" (office worker, object) performs a ritual, pan | behaviour 20-32 push | contact 32-40 the species notices, snap | turn 40-48 the species speaks or the observer gives herself away, whip, silence. Turn: species.
F14 Unboxing 45s: ch_liza, pl_unboxing_desk, handheld selfie. "Всем привет" 0-5 | box 5-12 still | layers 12-28 push | content 28-36 snap | turn 36-45 the content answers or the blogger's verdict, still. Turn: content or blogger.
F15 Podcast 48s: ch_nurlan + guest, pl_podcast, calm. Intro 0-6 slow push | thesis 6-18 still | "это глубоко" 18-32 slow push | sponsor read 32-38 still | turn 38-48 guest reveals who they really are, snap. Turn: guest.

title: PUPPET format F16-F18: tutorial, support call, startup pitch
text:
# PUPPET format F16-F18: tutorial, support call, startup pitch
tags: format, F16, F17, F18, туториал, поддержка, питч
F16 Tutorial 45s: "Как сделать X за пять шагов". Goal 0-5 still | steps 1-2 5-15 still | steps 3-4 15-30 get strange, push | result 30-38 pull | turn 38-45 step five or an answer to a comment, snap. Turn: presenter.
F17 Support call 45s: ch_sveta + caller, cut between them. Hold music 0-6 "ваш звонок важен" still | greeting 6-10 | problem 10-22 still | script 22-34 "вы пробовали выключить и включить?" push | turn 34-45 the fix, or who is really calling whom, snap. Turn: operator or caller.
F18 Startup pitch 45s: ch_danya, investor ch_viktor, pl_pitch_stage. Problem 0-8 "каждый день миллионы людей..." push | solution 8-18 snap | numbers 18-28 still | investor question 28-36 still | turn 36-45 founder's answer or the jury's decision, snap. Turn: investor.

F19 Family dinner 45s: pl_dining. Gathering 0-5 pan down | small talk 5-18 whip between lines | question 18-25 "ну, как у тебя дела?" push | confession 25-37 still, silence | turn 37-45 the eldest's reaction or bigger news, snap. Turn: eldest.
F20 School lesson 45s: ch_natalya, pl_school. Topic 0-6 still | explanation 6-18 pan | pupil raises a hand 18-28 push | teacher's life example 28-36 still | turn 36-45 homework or the pupil's line, snap. Adults and the system are funny, never the child. Turn: teacher or pupil.
F21 Doctor 45s: ch_olga, pl_clinic. "На что жалуемся?" 0-5 | complaint 5-15 still | exam 15-25 "дышите", push | diagnosis 25-35 slow push | turn 35-45 the prescription, snap. Turn: doctor.

title: PUPPET format F22-F25: taxi, museum, apartment tour, wedding toast
text:
# PUPPET format F22-F25: taxi, museum, apartment tour, wedding toast
tags: format, F22, F23, F24, F25, такси, музей, показ квартиры, свадебный тост
F22 Taxi 45s: ch_rustam, pl_taxi, handheld throughout. "Куда едем?" 0-5 | route 5-15 argues with navigator, shake | monologue 15-30 | traffic 30-36 still | turn 36-45 the fare or who the driver is, snap. Turn: driver.
F23 Museum 45s: ch_lev, pl_museum; exhibits are things of today. "Перед вами..." 0-6 pull | exhibit 6-18 push | exhibit 18-30 pan | visitor asks 30-36 handheld | turn 36-45 answer or the exhibit speaks, snap. Turn: guide or exhibit.
F24 Apartment tour 45s: ch_karina, pl_apartment_empty. "Проходите!" 0-5 handheld | room 5-18 pan | flaws as features 18-30 snap each | price 30-36 push | turn 36-45 the last "advantage", pull. Turn: realtor.
F25 Wedding toast 45s: pl_wedding_hall. Glass clink 0-4 snap | "я знаю их давно" 4-14 handheld | story 14-28 less and less fitting, push on the groom | wishes like contract terms 28-36 still | turn 36-45 last phrase, hall freezes, snap, silence. Turn: speaker.

title: PUPPET: common mistakes to avoid
text:
# PUPPET: common mistakes to avoid
tags: mistakes, pitfalls, review, before check
Before you run check, scan the program for these:
- Lines too long: more than 2 words per second of shot. Split or cut words before check, not after.
- say on a place set (pl_...): places have no mouth. Use voice, or show the speaker's ch_ set.
- Shot times that do not touch, or a gap after a silent beat. Each shot starts where the last ended.
- at= written in shot seconds (at 0.3s in every shot). Use film seconds: shot start + 0.3.
- snap= outside its own shot. snap is a film second inside the shot.
- Music under the last line. Stop it 3-6 s earlier.
- The same camera on every shot. Vary: still host, pushing guest, one snap at the end.
- A last line that explains, moralises or asks the viewer. Cut it to the fact.
- A host who jokes. The host is straight; only the situation is absurd.
- Real names, brands, cities, countries, religion. Replace with invented ones.
- Film shorter than 30 s or longer than 60 s. Aim for 40-50 s.
- Prose around the program. Output only the program.
